general.notes: Technology CWDM XFP. Transmission media SM (2x LC). Nominal wavelength 1470nm – 1610nm (8ch); overview also states 1270nm to 1610nm (8 CWDM versions). Transmit wavelength 1471 – 1611nm (G.694.2). Receiver wavelength range 1260nm – 1620nm. Typical reach 80km @ 1470~1550nm and 70km @ 1550~1610nm; ordering codes specify 80km (C47–C53) or 70km (C55–C61). Power budget 14 – 24dB. Dispersion penalty max 1dB. Transmitter output power footnote 1) Average power (min listed as 0.0dB, max +4.0dBm). Receiver minimum input power footnote 2) @ 10.3Gbps, BER 1x10-12, PRBS 231-1. DDM Yes. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Note: 10GBASE-ZR/ZW is an industry standard defined only at 1550nm; referred from bridgeable distance perspective for other wavelengths within the CWDM band.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether transmitter min output 0.0dB is intended as dBm. Map power budget 14–24dB and title '24dB' if a dedicated field is needed. Dispersion penalty max 1dB lacks paired penalized metric and conditions for structured penalty objects.
